# VitalQuant

> VitalQuant is an early-stage research and prototyping company in London, UK building a
> multimodal wearable sensing platform for early detection of post-operative physiological
> deterioration (e.g. sepsis). Stage: early research + working prototype — not a medical
> device, not clinically validated; model outputs are experimental scores, not diagnoses.

## Product

- Wearable sensor node (ESP32): dual-wavelength PPG (MAX86141/MAX30102, 660+880 nm, 200 Hz),
  11-channel spectral (AS7341), contact temperature (MLX90637/MLX90614), environment
  (BME280), 6-axis IMU (ICM-42670-P/MPU6050), contact force (FSR402).
- Platform: FastAPI ingest API (idempotent batch writes, per-device keys, clock correction),
  signal-quality-gated processing pipeline, 7-schema Postgres data model (raw/clean/quality/
  features/ml/config/meta) with real/synthetic/simulated provenance tags.
- Model: LAT-D-VQt-1, a closed-weight clinical time-series decision model (built with
  LatticeAG) answering a fixed deterioration question set from wearable channels only.
- Quantum-inspired readout simulator with a composable noise hierarchy; measured squeezed-
  readout SNR advantage 2.72x (shot-noise regime) -> 1.14x (tissue-noise regime).
